ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

4. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

6. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 6
   D. 11

7. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 5

8. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 8
   D. 16

10. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 56

12. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
